original.subject: Public Statement for Harwick Fairgrounds Drone Sighting
original.body:
Harwick UAS Operations Group confirms no aircraft were airborne during the Harwick Fairgrounds event. We are supporting Harwick Police and have not launched any UAS. No Group aircraft were in the air at the time of the reported drone sighting.

This statement is approved by the General Manager. Do not alter or post via internal channels.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO’s adherence to media protocol and prevents premature internal or social media dissemination. Watch for any attempt to bypass Corporate Communications or post the statement directly.
